mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and may theoretically reduce liraglutide levels, though liraglutide is primarily metabolized by dipeptidyl peptidase-4 and endogenous proteolysis rather than hepatic CYP450 enzymes.
action: Monitor glycemic control closely if co-administered; consider avoiding combination due to potential reduced liraglutide efficacy and liraglutide's narrow therapeutic index.
